title: IoT Engineer
summary: An IoT (Internet of Things) engineer connects sensors and devices to the cloud so their data can be collected, shown on dashboards and acted on. They sit between the firmware and cloud teams and own the whole path from device to gateway to cloud platform.
dailyDuties: Write device or gateway code that reads sensors
Publish device data to an MQTT broker or cloud IoT platform
Set up device provisioning and certificates
Ship and track over-the-air firmware updates
Debug Wi-Fi, BLE or cellular connection drops on field devices
Build dashboards and alerts for device data
Test prototypes with the hardware team

skills.expectation: Send device data over MQTT or CoAP to a broker
Connect devices to AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub or a similar platform
Work with Wi-Fi, BLE, cellular or LoRaWAN links
Program boards such as ESP32 or STM32
Provision devices and ship firmware updates over the air
Debug TCP/IP, TLS and gateway connectivity in the field
Write device or gateway code in C, C++ or Python
Write device or gateway code in C, C++ or Python
Write device or gateway code in C, C++ or Python
Read sensors and machines over I2C, SPI or Modbus
Build gateways on Raspberry Pi or embedded Linux
Package edge gateway software in containers
Build Grafana dashboards and alerts for device data

groups.label: A device or gateway language (C, C++ or Python)
